title: Wilmot
creator: CrossFit
description: Six rounds of 50 squats and 25 ring dips, for time. Honours Canadian Forces Pvt. Colin Wilmot of 2 PPCLI, killed by an explosive device in Panjwaii District, Afghanistan, in 2008. 150 ring dips; banded dips or bench dips are a reasonable scale.
